output.title: 130 m² 3-Bedroom Row House with Private Garden and Parking
output.description:
This 130 m² row house, built in the 1980s and well-maintained, offers a quiet residential setting with a neutral facade and a small front yard. The accommodation extends across multiple levels and includes three bedrooms and one bathroom.

The living room presents garden views through patio doors and features a dated interior with beige carpeting and an alcove suitable for a tube TV, indicating potential for modernization to suit personal tastes.

The property includes a private rear garden with a lawn area, enclosed by a wood fence, along with a small storage shed. Additional benefits include a dedicated parking space and a cellar for extra storage.

Situated in a residential locality characterized by similar 1980s housing, this home provides a balanced indoor and outdoor living environment with practical storage and parking facilities.
